newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Higher demand seen for aluminium in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Higher demand seen for aluminium in Europe.

text.p: European primary aluminium production was little changed in January-April, but there are indications demand will increase this year, the European Aluminium Association said.
The development of the production of aluminium semi products indicates increasing demand for primary aluminium in Europe for this year, EAA said in its quarterly report.
"Growth rates of primary aluminium consumption for the western world as a whole are projected in the order of 4-5 percent, with Europe fully recovering from the decrease in 1996," it added.
In January-April, production rose 0.6 percent to 1,081,065 tonnes.
